name: Content, sticky notes
description: A heading and short text beside a board of tilted sticky notes, each holding one short thought.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.default: Five things we tell everyone who wheels a bike in

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.default: Halden Cycle Works has fixed bikes on Mill Street since 2009. These notes have hung above the truing stand for most of that time, and they are still the best advice we have.

itemFields.name: text
itemFields.label: Thought
itemFields.default: Lock the frame, not just the wheel.

default.text: Pump your tyres every two weeks. It fixes half of what people bring in.
default.author: Dana

default.text: If it clicks, bring it in. Clicks never fix themselves.
default.author: Marek

default.text: A clean chain lasts three times longer than a dirty one.
We would rather sell you a 9 euro cable than a 600 euro bike.
default.author: Dana

default.text: Tea is free while you wait. Always.
default.author: Ines
